objective: Review the future runtime-attempt boundary after the non-executing observable-ordering helper and decide whether a scoped run may attempt launcher start from exact structured argv without treating this review as runtime attempt, launcher start, sidecar execution, bridge-path compare, timing, broad native option support, arbitrary filelist support, automatic allocation, runtime/ABI change, raw-state equality, direct Verilator sidecar execution, or production throughput evidence.

review_decision.reason: The definition is narrow enough for one scoped future runtime attempt. It requires the reviewed non-executing observable-ordering helper output, keeps launcher-start-allowed status separate from launcher process start evidence, limits the launcher command to exact structured argv for pulp_ita_mha 64x1, and preserves distinct failure classes for launcher invocation, sidecar stages, compare, and timing claims.
review_decision.weakest_point: The next run may attempt launcher start, but this review still proves no runtime attempt, launcher process start, sidecar stage, bridge-path compare, timing, direct Verilator sidecar execution, broad native option support, arbitrary filelists, automatic allocation, runtime/ABI change, raw-state equality, or production throughput.
